# Phenk

> Public email inboxes for people and agents. Any name is an inbox: mail sent
> to NAME@{{.Domain}} can be read by anyone who knows NAME. No account, no API
> key, no setup. Messages are deleted after {{.RetentionHours}} hours.

Use Phenk to receive an email during an automated task — a signup
confirmation, a one-time code, a magic sign-in link — and read it back over
HTTP. Phenk only receives mail. It never sends any.

## The whole flow

1. Pick a name nobody else will guess, such as `agent-7f3c9a21`. Anyone who
   knows a name can read its inbox, so use a fresh name for each task and do
   not put anything private through it.
2. Enter `NAME@{{.Domain}}` in the form that sends the email.
3. Wait for the email. This holds the request open for up to
   {{.MaxWaitSeconds}} seconds and returns as soon as mail arrives:

       GET {{.BaseURL}}/v1/named/NAME/wait?timeout={{.MaxWaitSeconds}}

   The response is `{"messages": [...], "cursor": N, "timed_out": false}`.
   If `timed_out` is true nothing arrived yet: call it again.
4. Read the code or the link. Every message carries what was detected in it:

       "extracted": {
         "codes": [{"value": "482913", "context": "Your code is 482913."}],
         "links": [{"url": "https://…", "text": "Verify email", "kind": "verify"}]
       }

   The code you want is almost always `messages[0].extracted.codes[0].value`.
   The link you want is the first one whose `kind` is `verify`.

## Waiting for the next email

Every response includes a `cursor`. Pass it back as `since` and only mail that
arrived after it is returned — which is how you wait for a second email
without seeing the first one again:

    GET {{.BaseURL}}/v1/named/NAME/wait?since=CURSOR&timeout={{.MaxWaitSeconds}}

To ignore anything already in an inbox before you trigger an email, list it
first and wait from its cursor:

    GET {{.BaseURL}}/v1/named/NAME/messages

## Other endpoints

- `GET {{.BaseURL}}/v1/named/NAME/latest` — the newest message, in full.
- `GET {{.BaseURL}}/v1/messages/MESSAGE_ID` — one message: `text`, sanitized
  `html`, `attachments`, and `extracted`.
- `GET {{.BaseURL}}/v1/messages/MESSAGE_ID/raw` — the original MIME message.
- `GET {{.BaseURL}}/v1/meta` — the domains on offer and the limits above.

`NAME` may also be a full address, `NAME@{{.Domain}}`. Names are 3 to 64
characters of lower-case letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores, and
start with a letter or digit. A `+tag` is ignored.

## Things to know

- Detected codes and links are found by rules, not guaranteed. If a code is
  rejected, read its `context`, or the message `text`.
- Never follow a link whose `kind` is `unsubscribe` when you meant to verify.
- Creating an inbox for a name that has never been used is rate limited per
  client address. Reading and waiting on an existing inbox is not.
- Inboxes are public. Do not send passwords, personal data, or anything you
  would not post publicly to one.
